meta.title: Little Furnace — order from your table by QR code
meta.description: Scan the code on your table, pick dishes and place the order. The kitchen gets it right away, no waiting for a server.

hero.line2: A second later it is in the kitchen.
hero.subtitle: Scan the code on your table, pick dishes and place the order. No waiting for a server — the kitchen gets the order right away.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
steps: Scan the QR code on the table
Pick dishes and add a note
Follow its status on your phone

staff.text: For front-of-house and kitchen staff. Sign in with your account.
